howto.text: Try the left window: click sessions, New session, the Live items, the sidebar toggle and the side-panel button. Tweaks change theme (dark or light), glass strength, accent colour, collapsed sidebar, side panel and the new-session view.

title.text: Vector Signature: one calm sidebar with the Codex and Claude finish

rowChat.text: The blend: Signature sidebar, today's buttons made smaller, the Signature chatbar

rowChatNote.text:
Chat is the blended main screen. Today's top buttons are kept, just smaller: branch, Ready, Tasks, Changes, Terminal, usage, context ring. The chatbar follows the Signature design, and the sidebar footer is today's account row (You · Codium Max). Project logos are gone everywhere.

Tweaks: view (session, running, permission, new), pickers below or inside the box, purple or neutral active buttons.

Changes is today's panel, unchanged.

rowBrowser.text: Browser: three ways to show the page Vector is using

rowBrowserNote.text:
A Beside: the page docks in the side panel while you keep chatting. Recommended as the default.

B Run view: the page fills the screen and the chat floats on top. For long browser jobs you want to watch or take over.

C Inspect: a device preview with console and network drawers, and pick-an-element. For building web pages.

The state tweak on each board shows: empty, idle, Vector driving, you in control, waiting for you.

rowScopeNote.text:
The overview lists your open pull requests and their review status. A review run shows the findings, with a filter for blocking issues, concerns and nits, plus each finding's evidence.

This replaces today's full-window Vectorscope popup.

rowSettings.text: Settings with the sidebar still visible

rowSettingsNote.text:
General, Default models and Account. Account keeps today's avatar, name and plan.

The shell tweak on each board switches to today's full-window settings, so you can compare the two.

rowOtherNote.text: Search (⌘K) now also finds settings. Connected tools is where Vectorscope, Hands and the cloud computer link to the agent. Automations lists scheduled and triggered runs, with a create view.

rowPanes.text: Coming to Vector: Plan, Artifacts and an iOS simulator in the side panel

rowPanesNote.text:
Plan, Artifacts and the iOS Simulator become side-panel tabs next to Changes and Browser. One new Panels button after Terminal opens them (also from ⌘K). Tasks, Changes and Terminal stay as they are.

Plan shows the plan Vector writes in Plan mode, with Approve and run or Keep planning. Artifacts collects the pages, docs and diagrams a session makes. The Simulator runs your iOS app; the sample app is Vector Remote.

These show where each feature would live. None is built yet.

rowAgent.text: Coming to Vector: On-call, computer use as commands, and a quick tour

rowAgentNote.text:
On-call is a sixth sidebar item, after Automations. It lists requests from GitHub, Slack, Linear and Jira (@vector), what Vector did, and the result: a pull request or a reply. Its rules and hours cover jobs on this Mac, and Vector never merges or deploys.

Computer use is a command, not a button: /computer, /cloud, /browser, /simulator, /plan, /vectorscope, also in ⌘K. The chatbar cloud button goes away.

The tour is a welcome card and four short stops: chatbar, sidebar, top buttons, Search. Replay it from Help › Take the tour.
